evidence.positive: Shipped config, API level: staged an 83 kg adult on mgb-mgh via the admin API and called POST /api/cds/medication-selection/{pmrn}/{caseId} for m-heparin. perRouteState.INTRAVENOUS.defaultIndication = "Procedural" with Procedural amounts 2,100 / 4,200 / 5,000 / 6,600 units (CPB 12,500 / 24,900 and ECMO also present, none preselected); SUBCUTANEOUS.defaultIndication = "Prophylaxis". App log: 'Applying guidance SetIndicationDoseOptions[indicationDoseOptions={Procedural=[2,100 units, ...]}, defaultIndication=Procedural]'. The DB rows behind this are the shipped import: mayo-mayo, mgb-mgh and mgb-icsnh each carry exactly m-heparin and m-heparin-pf INTRAVENOUS/Procedural and SUBCUTANEOUS/Prophylaxis with default_indication = true (12 rows total), demo-demo none. UI level (Playwright, loopuser, real dosing form): copied the four mgb-mgh m-heparin indication rows into demo-demo and launched a staged 83 kg demo case. Heparin opened on Intravenous with the Procedural button selected, only the Procedural amounts shown (4,200 / 5,000 / 6,600 units at demo's 50/60/80 units/kg options), no dose button selected and the Dose input empty (screenshot positive-open.png). Clicking Subcutaneous selected Prophylaxis automatically; clicking Intravenous again re-selected Procedural; clicking the selected Procedural cleared it and the list expanded to all seven IV amounts (500 through 8,300 units); clicking CPB selected CPB. Picking 4,200 units and saving with Procedural still preselected stored medication_administrations row dose_amount 4200 units, route INTRAVENOUS, indication 'Procedural' (Theo's concern: the preselected indication is recorded like a clicked one).
evidence.negative: Medication with indications but no marker, shipped config: POST medication-selection for m-epinephrine on mgb-mgh returned defaultIndication = null on INTRAVENOUS, INTRAOSSEOUS and INTRATHECAL, with Hypotension/Anaphylaxis/Code options intact; log line ended 'defaultIndication=null]'. Marker explicitly false: set default_indication = false on the demo-demo heparin rows and re-ran the API (both routes null) and the UI: Heparin opened with Intravenous selected, no Indication button selected, all seven IV amounts listed; switching to Subcutaneous and back left nothing selected (all amounts, both routes); a manual click on Procedural still selected it and narrowed the list to three amounts. Medication with no indication rows at all: after deleting the copied rows, demo heparin returned indications {} and defaultIndication null on both routes, i.e. today's behaviour.
evidence.red_check: Two red checks, both reverted. (1) Data flip: set default_indication = true on mgb-mgh m-epinephrine ADULT INTRAVENOUS Hypotension. The API immediately returned INTRAVENOUS.defaultIndication = "Hypotension" (other routes null) and the app log printed 'Applying guidance SetIndicationDoseOptions[indicationDoseOptions={Hypotension=[5 mcg, 10 mcg], Anaphylaxis=[50 mcg, 100 mcg], Code=[1,000 mcg]}, defaultIndication=Hypotension]'. Reverted the row; re-ran, all routes null again. Same flip on demo-demo through the UI: EPINEPHrine opened with Hypotension pre-selected and only 5 / 10 mcg listed; reverted, re-opened, no indication selected and all five amounts. (2) Pre-fix class swap: compiled the parent commit's MedicationIndicationDoseOptionsRule (lombok @Slf4j replaced with an explicit logger) inside the container against /app/classes:/app/libs/*, backed up the shipped classes, swapped the pre-fix classes into /app/classes and restarted. With the DB rows still marked default, heparin on mgb-mgh returned defaultIndication = null on both routes, i.e. the positive went red. Restored MedicationIndicationDoseOptionsRule.class from the backup and the inner RouteCitationInfo class from a fresh container of the same image, md5 69e189d453f8bae346f5ee5a2e167c56 and fe7429adaf9b28e8fc261859cde079cc both match the image, restarted, and the positive returned Procedural / Prophylaxis again. Final DB state: the 12 shipped default rows and nothing else.

caveats: The UI was exercised on demo-demo with the four mgb-mgh heparin indication rows copied in, because MGB and Mayo app-launch need Epic locally; the configured sites were verified at the API/DB level only.

demo's heparin weight-based options are 50/60/80/100 units/kg, so the UI showed three Procedural amounts rather than the ticket's four; mgb-mgh via the API showed the exact 2,100 / 4,200 / 5,000 / 6,600.
m-heparin-pf and the mayo-mayo / mgb-icsnh tenants were checked only as DB rows (identical defaults), not through the selection endpoint.
The importer's duplicate-default warning path was not exercised at runtime (unit tested in the PR).
Compliance scoring of a dose saved under a preselected indication was checked only as far as the stored indication column, not a compliance verdict.

automation.assessment: The PR adds unit coverage for the importer (per-site defaults, duplicate handling), DosingFormState and the rule's per-route default map. qa-suite has no coverage of the indication section of the dosing form at all. The behaviour worth locking in is the UI contract: preselection on open, re-application on route change, clear-on-click, and the stored indication on save. Catch: the dev qa-suite runs against demo-demo, whose shipped indication CSV deliberately marks no default (the PR's demoSiteMarksNoDefaultIndication test asserts that), so a UI test needs either a demo default marker (e.g. Procedural on demo heparin, mirroring the sites) or an API-level test against a configured tenant.

jira_comment:
Verdict: deploy-ready.

Positive: On the shipped mgb-mgh config an 83 kg adult's IV heparin selection returned Procedural as the default with the 2,100 / 4,200 / 5,000 / 6,600 unit list, and in the real dosing form Procedural opened pre-selected, route switching re-applied the per-route default, clicking it cleared it, and a save recorded the preselected indication.
Negative: Epinephrine, which has indications but no marker, opened with no indication selected and every amount listed, as did heparin rows with the marker set to false.
Red check: Marking epinephrine Hypotension as the default made it open pre-selected in both the API and the UI, and swapping in the pre-fix rule class dropped the heparin default to null despite the marked rows; both reverted and re-verified green.

Automation: Five supplemental dosing-form tests proposed, pending a decision on whether demo should carry a default marker.
